name: computer
summary: Operate a Mac app in the background for the user (e.g. calculate in Calculator, write or edit a document in TextEdit/Pages, change an app's view). Only when no dedicated tool fits; you approve the goal first. Off-limits: Terminal, Keychain, Disk Utility; Settings is read-only.

args.app: string: the app's name, e.g. Calculator
args.goal: string: what to achieve in that app, self-contained
